narr: Thunderstorms with heavy rain produced flash flooding across portions of northern Arizona.
ev: An estimated two feet of water flowing through Banning Creek over the low water crossing on East School House Gulch Road in the community of Groom Creek.
The Snowflake-Taylor Police Department reported flash flooding in Snowflake with 6 inches of water over the roadways and houses threatened in the West 1st Street area.
